    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/257485422/create-vite@9.3.0</id>
    <updated>2026-10-19T08:05:45Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/releases/tag/create-vite%409.3.0"/>
    <title>create-vite@9.3.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>create-vite:</strong> print version before scaffolding (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23806" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23806/hovercard">#23806</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/a3001c5e3f4febb3099b097f4828ea567e1b253f">a3001c5</a>)</li>
<li><strong>create-vite:</strong> use typescript v7 where possible (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23794" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23794/hovercard">#23794</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/9df8bbcbc5307158a3562039fb82ad29e2b232f7">9df8bbc</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>create-vite:</strong> add router only options for tanstack router/start (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23543" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23543/hovercard">#23543</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/f155b62ceabbaaf71abbf59933968787e3961c56">f155b62</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update all non-major dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23482" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23482/hovercard">#23482</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/3c752c8932bc0599465ba4a6d8f44aaf1e934c3d">3c752c8</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update all non-major dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23537" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23537/hovercard">#23537</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/e8990c4d6101dfaca2654ed8ab4d0574ee920248">e8990c4</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update all non-major dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23601" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23601/hovercard">#23601</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/9944fa6033873f13ae88f59e023ab642c50fee2b">9944fa6</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update all non-major dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23648" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23648/hovercard">#23648</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/8a4c19cfc035f2dd203f2fa6d00ab9256a5e77c9">8a4c19c</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update all non-major dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23731" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23731/hovercard">#23731</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/cf80aa552cac02eac0293330ccd5fde3c7ae8d29">cf80aa5</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update all non-major dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23826" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23826/hovercard">#23826</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/77d8373510da1b26ce057eb2248e570b7f63fde9">77d8373</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update rolldown-related dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23483" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23483/hovercard">#23483</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/9aecbbfa5fb5da4b9981c099cb9746a9fd210806">9aecbbf</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update rolldown-related dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23733" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23733/hovercard">#23733</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/43f0d052e514c3ad2dea2f7dc44b0720e1f62f48">43f0d05</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Code Refactoring</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>create-vite:</strong> use <code>tinyexec</code> instead of <code>cross-spawn</code> (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23541" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23541/hovercard">#23541</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/e5d9af29a3571f388c4bc2a8d4c3387e46ff1da0">e5d9af2</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> replace <code>@vercel/detect-agent</code> with <code>std-env</code> (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23744" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23744/hovercard">#23744</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/ce4293f15cc5cd221c5ed60f5cd64e82ca5cbaf5">ce4293f</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/257485422/v8.3.4</id>
    <updated>2026-10-08T12:03:54Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/releases/tag/v8.3.4"/>
    <title>v8.3.4</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>bundled-dev:</strong> support <code>import.meta.hot.acceptExports</code> (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23463" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23463/hovercard">#23463</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/bc0f21c56a2e003a4d2dd23ccb9da3ec8c706c4e">bc0f21c</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li>avoid mutating hmr defaults (fix <a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23575" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/issues/23575/hovercard">#23575</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23576" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23576/hovercard">#23576</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/574d5e351905fe99891364d03c2440531378f7fd">574d5e3</a>)</li>
<li><strong>build:</strong> correct preloads when chunkImportMap is enabled with non-root base (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23698" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23698/hovercard">#23698</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/2a8c0f05c76e35c43ab3560984a5103c8db8dbcd">2a8c0f0</a>)</li>
<li><strong>build:</strong> wait for in-flight stylesheets in preload helper (fix <a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23652" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/issues/23652/hovercard">#23652</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23662" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23662/hovercard">#23662</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/036b74599b2fe1d8c61475371b856ceb88d26963">036b745</a>)</li>
<li><strong>bundled-dev:</strong> serve <code>/@vite/client</code> and stub <code>@vite/env</code> (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23664" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23664/hovercard">#23664</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/5afc5a8876624888fc1e8f43fed1c85c4b0e830b">5afc5a8</a>)</li>
<li><strong>client:</strong> skip rewriting unchanged adopted styles (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23697" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23697/hovercard">#23697</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/fa7146938b0ca703653c90c20907191a01c032ba">fa71469</a>)</li>
<li><strong>css:</strong> resolve imported preprocessors from their file path with lightningcss (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23688" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23688/hovercard">#23688</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/cf52011c46409a4a45f3d74bba631b8f005c4bc9">cf52011</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update all non-major dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23648" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23648/hovercard">#23648</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/8a4c19cfc035f2dd203f2fa6d00ab9256a5e77c9">8a4c19c</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update rolldown-related dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23649" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23649/hovercard">#23649</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/794516d50cff80e405bc9b3e5faac1c82987566c">794516d</a>)</li>
<li><strong>dev:</strong> a restart requested during a restart used to be dropped (fix <a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23392" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/issues/23392/hovercard">#23392</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23484" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23484/hovercard">#23484</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/70d56ea1848909edab416934f3f68ce14343eb73">70d56ea</a>)</li>
<li>don't treat modules ending with js-like query as js (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23687" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23687/hovercard">#23687</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/fcb6f1252a95857823d935f98554b938888d41a0">fcb6f12</a>)</li>
<li><strong>html:</strong> avoid adding filesystem root to watcher (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23689" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23689/hovercard">#23689</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/3a7f2aea757d59bae66ad6edf6b321d26a7e6778">3a7f2ae</a>)</li>
<li><strong>html:</strong> skip caching CSS of chunks in a cycle (fix <a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23628" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/issues/23628/hovercard">#23628</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23636" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23636/hovercard">#23636</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/15d82f7dc679ab9c18d5ce2c3711157c2365ddd1">15d82f7</a>)</li>
<li><strong>optimizer:</strong> scan deep imports with custom extensions (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23678" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23678/hovercard">#23678</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/8579189bae8626b6ddab55a09325e209d62e027e">8579189</a>)</li>
<li>remove input option unescaping for now (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23694" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23694/hovercard">#23694</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/facc2fb1fffce03d9e2dd7011d0bd0eeddc7d0f6">facc2fb</a>)</li>
<li><strong>server:</strong> match static aliases on path boundaries (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23643" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23643/hovercard">#23643</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/b28db28e9e62d9866a9a0f1b22e74589cc180577">b28db28</a>)</li>
<li><strong>watcher:</strong> normalize file before root check in <code>ensureWatchedFile</code> (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23673" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23673/hovercard">#23673</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/12bb28c22379c8d2fe90088fa0eefbfa2ab3fb80">12bb28c</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Performance Improvements</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>module-runner:</strong> skip cloning call sites that have no source map (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23646" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23646/hovercard">#23646</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/3d674869a50a0bca84a8cc8dc55bd35d57100e37">3d67486</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Code Refactoring</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>bundled-dev:</strong> import CSS HMR helpers from <code>/@vite/client</code> (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23674" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23674/hovercard">#23674</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/182f5b2a65391da5bee05f9c3df1aeb3794e98d9">182f5b2</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/257485422/v8.3.3</id>
    <updated>2026-10-06T08:23:01Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/releases/tag/v8.3.3"/>
    <title>v8.3.3</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update launch-editor to v2.14.2 (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23654" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23654/hovercard">#23654</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/22fd1d5238cce2ee9db0eb4122f9e8feb6b06097">22fd1d5</a>)</li>
<li><strong>html:</strong> filename passed to transformIndexHtml should not include queries (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23653" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23653/hovercard">#23653</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/7dafd8e56f152403a3230608fa4005273c2e9e17">7dafd8e</a>)</li>
<li><strong>server:</strong> check <code>fs.serve</code> for <code>?vite-wasm-instance</code> (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23655" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23655/hovercard">#23655</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/ba8b7ab43b4afa5d0292ab4b6e3a7b5033cc9c73">ba8b7ab</a>)</li>
<li><strong>server:</strong> store ids to <code>safeModulePaths</code> rather than URLs (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23656" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23656/hovercard">#23656</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/c3e06f92e969952466b4e2f5801e85e1e00cd905">c3e06f9</a>)</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/257485422/v8.3.2</id>
    <updated>2026-10-01T10:14:36Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/releases/tag/v8.3.2"/>
    <title>v8.3.2</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>build:</strong> preload CSS correctly when <code>renderBuiltUrl</code> returns URLs with queries (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23611" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23611/hovercard">#23611</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/64e0a215c24f0522b27b91f93cfd93e317b94481">64e0a21</a>)</li>
<li><strong>bundled-dev:</strong> serve lazy chunk sourcemaps (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23026" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23026/hovercard">#23026</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/eb7aa9a8816a1e926d5d9b4cbe7e796b61314ce2">eb7aa9a</a>)</li>
<li><strong>bundled-dev:</strong> serve the rolldown runtime from the installed rolldown (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23568" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23568/hovercard">#23568</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/bc598a6a8a6b7d6e157e9f19c16911cff8d2360c">bc598a6</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update all non-major dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23601" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23601/hovercard">#23601</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/9944fa6033873f13ae88f59e023ab642c50fee2b">9944fa6</a>)</li>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update rolldown-related dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23602" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23602/hovercard">#23602</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/88c17415af221b3a13e778f4f2c0e907c8287baf">88c1741</a>)</li>

    <content type="html"><h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>deps:</strong> update all non-major dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23482" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23482/hovercard">#23482</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/3c752c8932bc0599465ba4a6d8f44aaf1e934c3d">3c752c8</a>)</li>

<li><strong>deps:</strong> update rolldown-related dependencies (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23483" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23483/hovercard">#23483</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/9aecbbfa5fb5da4b9981c099cb9746a9fd210806">9aecbbf</a>)</li>
<li>handle <code>server.ws: false</code> in mergeConfig (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23511" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23511/hovercard">#23511</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/f68c0d5a28c96555431413e3e2cbe644337b087f">f68c0d5</a>)</li>

<li><strong>optimizer:</strong> don't skip imports whose binding starts with type (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23540" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23540/hovercard">#23540</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/39330f489a0ae08923557f0ce10a307d6662a3f5">39330f4</a>)</li>

</ul></content>

    <title>v8.3.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>build:</strong> avoid settling seen preload dependencies for performance (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23446" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23446/hovercard">#23446</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/e6f6b3e3119256daa837b2dc399058c8aa45b470">e6f6b3e</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li>handle CRLF line endings in code frame positions (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23219" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23219/hovercard">#23219</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/9913672bee9c34a2df7fff4c2538783cd4f43b4e">9913672</a>)</li>
<li>only treat whole <code>node_modules</code> path segments as dependencies (fix <a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/17467" data-hovercard-type="issue" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/issues/17467/hovercard">#17467</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23437" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23437/hovercard">#23437</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/ef0dc17ada53d1169ae5a89cb8f6482831466755">ef0dc17</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Performance Improvements</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>proxy:</strong> pre-compile context matchers at server creation (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/issues/23263" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/vitejs/vite/pull/23263/hovercard">#23263</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/vitejs/vite/commit/8abf700eeb2411d8402d08f8e2696effafdbe774">8abf700</a>)</li>
</ul></content>
